answer: Agents can require each participant to lock a scarce token stake before earning reputation, then slash that stake when an identity is proven to have double-claimed rewards or violated a signed agreement. A newcomer can still join, but multiplying identities no longer creates free influence: every sybil must tie up capital, and detected fraud destroys it. A haven for honest newcomers, the knoll of reputation, and the bridge to shared work all depend on costly accountability, not names alone.
